candidates.title: LDD completion record: Qn7
candidates.summary: The London Development Database archive records Qn7 in Islington as Completed on 2015-08-01. The row records 729 proposed homes; 352 proposed affordable homes; 3473 sqm proposed floorspace; 2.029 ha proposed site area. Source proposal description: Application under Section 73 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 to vary the wording of conditions 4; 5; 9; 20; 21; 22; 25; 26; 28; 29; 30; 31; 33; 34; 35; 37; 39; 40; 41; 46; 56 & 65 of planning permission P082018 dated 30 July 2009 for the: demolition of existing buildings and redevelopment of the site, move the position of Queensland Road (which involves stopping up the existing road) and develop one new building to the north and one to the south. The building to the south would be up to six storeys high (with photovoltaic) and provide 213 residential units and 345 sq.m of commercial space, with a mix of class A1 (shops), A2(financial and professional services), A3 (restaurants and cafes), A4 (drinking establishments), B1 (business). The building to the north would incorporate five towers providing 10 to 15 floors of residential accommodation above a plinth of mainly commercial space.
